events.title: One-On-One Tech Help (English or Tiếng Việt)

cases.refreshed: Offered in English or Tiếng Việt. Do you need help using a computer? Want to set up an email account? Stop by the Santa Teresa Branch Library for a session with our experienced volunteer! They can assist you with basic tech issues, such as: Setting up an email account, composing & sending emails, using email attachments; Web searches and basic data entry; Learning the basics of Microsoft Word and Excel and web-based productivity software such as Google Docs; Using the library's pay-for-print and photocopy machines; Downloading apps on your phone or tablet; And much more! You are welcome to bring your own device, such as a laptop, phone or tablet, or you can use one of our computers. Free, No registration required

cases.refreshed: Confused by your computer? Get personalized tech assistance. Help is available for basic tasks such as: Printing; Using email; Connecting to Wi-Fi; Creating documents; Accessing library resources. Registering for an appointment is optional. If you register for an appointment, it can start at any time between 3 p.m. and 4:30 pm. Please contact Sarah Kishler at sarah.kishler@sjlibrary.org or 408-808-3075 to let us know what time you would like to come in. When there is space, walk-ins starting between 3 p.m. and 4:30 p.m. are also welcome.

cases.refreshed: Infant and Toddler Storytime invites children and their caregivers to wiggle, rhyme, and sing with diverse books, songs, and fingerplays that encourage language, play, and exploration. This program is geared for children 0 to 3 years of age and their parents/caregivers, but all children are welcome! After Storytime concludes, we invite you to Stay & Play! Until 12 PM the Storytime librarian and special toys will be on the Children's Room floor to keep the fun going. Meet new friends, play with toys, chat, get book recommendations, and maybe even create something! Storytime: 11:00-11:30 AM; Stay & Play: 11:30 AM-12:00 PM. This program is developed to align with the Early Education Quality Standards.

cases.refreshed: This leadership and volunteer service group for teens ages 13-18 meets on the first [or 2nd if lands on closure] Wednesday of each month at 4:00 PM. Get involved, earn volunteer hours, and be a leader in the library. To join Teens Reach you must be 13-18 years of age, have a strong interest in the library, enjoy working with people of all ages and cultures, be reliable and communicative, and be willing to learn new skills. Membership requires regular attendance at meetings, participation, and support of library activities and events. A sense of fun and adventure is also appreciated. As a bonus, Teens Reach members can earn community service hours through participation in meetings and activities. Get some pizza at every meeting as well! Agendas & Activities: Wednesday, August 5, 2026 - Pick/Elect Leadership + Perler Beads; Wednesday, September 2, 2026 - Lanyards/Boondoggles; Saturday, October 10, 2026 - Halloween Decorations Upcycling / Woodworking; Wednesday, November 4, 2026 - Autumn/Diwali/Thanksgiving Themed Painting on 5x7 Canvas [Acrylic Paints]; Wednesday, December 2, 2026 - TBD; Wednesday, January 6, 2027 - TBD; Wednesday, February 3, 2027 - TBD; Wednesday, March 3, 2027 - TBD; Wednesday, April 7, 2027 - TBD; Wednesday, May 5, 2027 - TBD; Wednesday, June 2, 2027 - TBD. For more information go to www.sjpl.org/teensreach Registration not necessary, it is used as a headcount for room preparation. All teens welcome to the activities. Walk-ins okay.

cases.refreshed: Join us in this monthly workshop to learn operate 3D printing and Cricut machine. Available devices include Cricut Maker 3, Cricut Press, and a Creality 3D Printer. A limited selection of supplies for these machines will be available, but you're welcome to bring your own supplies and digital design files. You can also watch these tutorial videos ahead of time to get a better idea of how to use the Cricut machine and Design Space. We strongly recommend that you bring your own laptop. No registration required.

cases.refreshed: Need help with your homework or a subject in school? Students in Kindergarten through 6th grade can come to Joyce Ellington Branch Library on Wednesdays from 2 to 4 pm to get free assistance. Students can get help with their homework/school enrichment or use our Study Room as a space to work on school projects independently. Free. No registration required.

cases.refreshed: Cosmo Alleycats have been a favorite of the San Francisco music scene since the band's 2010 beginning. Led by jazz vocalist Emily Day, "one of the major singers in her field" (Scott Yanow), the group endears audiences with inviting musicality and playful improvisation.
